fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly on both sides to help responders locate it under low-visibility conditions such as smoke or darkness.
• Clear vegetation along both sides of the access drive to allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Trim back dense vegetation near the parking area to give responders room to stage equipment and move around vehicles.
• Keep the parking area clear of stored vehicles or objects so arriving emergency units have space to position.
• Create or clearly mark a turnaround point near the residence so large vehicles such as fire engines can reverse direction without becoming blocked.
• Thin dense vegetation between the parking area and the rear of the residence to give responders a clear path to the back of the structure.
• Cut back dense vegetation close to the residence on all accessible sides so responders can move around the building without obstruction.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back tree branches and shrubs that are directly touching or overhanging the roof and walls of the structure.
• Thin the tree clusters surrounding the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants growing at the base of trees near the structure.
• Clear dead leaves, needles, and branches that have accumulated on the roof and in gutters.
• Thin shrubs and small trees on both sides of the driveway to keep the access route open for vehicles.
• Trim any tree branches that hang over the driveway to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Keep the area immediately around the structure free of dry plant material, wood piles, and loose debris.
• Separate shrubs from one another where they are growing in dense groups near the structure to reduce continuous plant coverage.
• Thin scattered trees closest to the structure before addressing those farther out.
• Keep the single access route clear of fallen branches and overgrown vegetation at all times.
• Remove dead wood and dry material from within the tree clusters nearest to the structure.
